title: Tetsuya Tsutsui Launches New Ortrans Manga
content:
This year's 50th issue of Shueisha 's Young Jump magazine announced on November 12 that Tetsuya Tsutsui will launch a new series titled Ortrans in next year's eighth issue on January 21.

The story revolves around a series of disappearances of children from a juvenile training school. Two detectives on the case discover a disturbing video that seems to be related to the case.

Tsutsui launched the Neeting Life manga on Shueisha 's YanJan! app and on the Tonari no Young Jump website in December 2021, and ended it in January 2023.

Tsutsui launched the noise manga (pictured right) in Grand Jump in December 2017, and ended it in January 2020. Shueisha published the manga's third and final compiled book volume in March 2020. The manga inspired a live-action film that opened in Japan in January 2022.

Tsutsui launched the Prophecy ( Yokokuhan ) manga in Shueisha 's Jump X magazine in 2011, and ended it in August 2013. Shueisha published three volumes for the manga. Vertical published all three volumes. Fumio Obata launched a spinoff manga titled Yokokuhan: The Copycat in Jump X in April 2014, and ended it in 2015. The manga also received three volumes. Prophecy inspired a live-action film that opened in Japan in June 2015.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Super Needs to Bring Back Frieza’s Full Family
content:
Frieza has been the lone constant villain since Dragon Ball Z , and with the evil emperor still alive in the timeline, it’s time to bring his entire family into the fight. Some villains might boast more strength than him, but Frieza is the most dynamic, proving that he can build upon his powers while maintaining his relentless ruthlessness . He was wished back to life by Goku in order to help the Z Fighters win the Tournament of Power for Universe 7. The wish proved successful as Universe 7 ended up winning, but it obviously came at a cost of Frieza being alive and well.

The only logical next step for him would be to try and destroy his longtime nemesis Goku. In order to do that, he’ll need a lot of help considering the Frieza Force troop’s losses over the years. The best way to counter that is to get more high-tier fighters, which is where his family comes into play. King Cold is already a part of the current canon, but probably needs some significant power boosting after his decimation at the hands of Future Trunks. Next, it’s time to introduce Cooler to the Dragon Ball canon and really up the ante.

Cooler Waited Years For This

Frieza’s older brother is like the non-Saiyan version of the original Broly. First introduced 35 years ago in the Dragon Ball Z film Cooler’s Revenge , he’s in a lot of content, but all of it is now non-canon. Unlike his brother’s final form, Cooler’s masked face and towering physique make him a much more imposing fighter. Cooler recently achieved the Golden Cooler form in Super Dragon Ball Heroes , so the concept is out there that he can compete with this new godly level of Saiyan power in the later releases.

Cooler provides an immediate power up to his brother’s forces. However, he’s not the only member of the family that can fight. King Cold, their father, built an empire on conquering worlds and destroying civilizations. His minimal appearances don’t show off his skills, and his quick defeat in the lone battle he fought in undersells his skills. He’s currently dead but probably got plenty of training in the afterlife, as he’s currently in hell for his many vile acts. If Frieza brings him back, that family trio would definitely give the Z Fighters some problems.

Dragon Ball Manga Adds More To Frieza’s Powers

The most recent on-screen appearance for Frieza came in Dragon Ball Super: Broly , but he’s not sat idly by since taking a beating from the Legendary Super Saiyan. The Dragon Ball Super manga displays an even more powerful version of the villain. Frieza unveils that he found a hyperbolic time chamber that allowed him to further expand his powers and become Black Frieza in the Granolah the Survivor Saga . He defeats Goku and Vegeta easily and moves on.

His powered-up form combined with Golden Cooler, and just for fun, a transformed King Cold would provide maybe the toughest trio for Goku, Vegeta and friends to battle. Frieza is the only bad guy with the same tenacity as the Saiyan heroes and that’s why even though he continually loses, his threat always looms large. The setup is there for him and his family to get a shot at revenge. Do you think they should get another shot at the Saiyans? Would you want to see the Frieza family return? Let us know in the comments.

title: D.I.C.E. Awards Honors Nintendo Game Creator Shigeru Miyamoto With Inaugural Legend Award
content:
According to the AIAS, the Legend Award recognizes "an industry icon whose enduring vision continues to redefine interactive entertainment," and celebrates the impact and influence of "creators whose groundbreaking achievements have already earned lasting universal acclaim."

Miyamoto is the main designer of the first incarnations of some of Nintendo 's most celebrated, well-known, and long-running game franchises, including Mario Bros. , Donkey Kong , The Legend of Zelda , Pikmin , and Star Fox , and continued to be a main designer for some of those franchise 's later games. He also helped shape the concept behind the Wii, one of Nintendo 's most successful console platforms. He has the title of Representative Director and Creative Fellow at Nintendo .

Japan's Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology announced on October 22 the eight recipients for this year's prestigious Order of Culture award, and Nintendo game designer Miyamoto has become the first person in the gaming industry to receive the honor. The order is awarded to those "who have made outstanding contributions in developing" Japanese culture. The Emperor presented Miyamoto with the award on November 3, Japan's Culture Day. At a press conference at Nintendo in Kyoto, Miyamoto stated that as games are created by not just one person, but by many collaborating together, he honors their work with this award.

Miyamoto earned Japan's Person of Cultural Merit honor in 2019. He also earned Spain's prestigious Prince of Asturias Award in the category of Communications and Humanities in 2012.

Nintendo composer Kōji Kondō ( Super Mario Bros. , The Legend of Zelda ) earned the Hall of Fame award at the D.I.C.E. Awards in 2024.

At the 29th Annual D.I.C.E. Awards earlier this year, Death Stranding 2: On the Beach won the awards for "Outstanding Achievement in Audio Design" and "Outstanding Technical Achievement." Persona 5 : The Phantom X won "Mobile Game of the Year," and Mario Kart World won "Racing Game of the Year."

title: Here’s Where My Hero Academia’s Anime Really Went Wrong
content:
There’s no denying My Hero Academia is one of the most successful anime and manga franchises of all time. However, even with all the exceptional talents working to help the anime become a worldwide success, the adaptation can’t be said to be perfect. While the manga ended its serialization in August 2024, the anime wrapped up the main story in December last year. Following the emotional final season, the anime returned with a special episode to adapt the extra chapter from the final volume and also released a short following Eri’s story after the time-skip . Regardless of the controversial manga finale, fans had nothing but praise for the anime’s conclusion, even though Studio Bones didn’t change anything from the source material.

However, the anime’s earlier seasons weren’t adapted nearly as well as the final season. This isn’t simply about the visuals, but also how much the adaptation followed the main source. Season 5 is often considered the weakest season in the series due to the fact that the early episodes mostly focused on the U.A. students and the Joint Training Arc. Towards the second cour of the season, it adapted the My Villain Academia Arc, also known as the Meta Liberation Army Arc , which was ruined due to several factors.

My Hero Academia Season 5 Made Several Changes to My Villain Academia

The fifth season was the calm before the storm when the Meta Liberation Army was just preparing for the war against the heroes. During the My Villain Academia Arc, the story’s focus shifted completely to the League of Villains and their conflict with the Meta Liberation Army. However, fans were shocked by the number of changes made by the anime. The series not only took out a lot of character depth from characters such as Spinner and Re-Destro but also toned down the intense violence shown in the manga.

Horikoshi is known for his gritty art style with intricate details and bloody violence. He doesn’t shy away from highlighting the brutality of the hero society, but the anime adaptation often needs to worry about censorship, especially if it’s going to be broadcast on television. The manga was far more brutal during Shigaraki’s present and past in this arc. This is especially the case when it featured Garaki performing painful experiments on Shigaraki, where the manga made the scene look so much more disturbing.

The story itself doesn’t change much, but the way that the anime toned down the gritty details makes it much less impactful. We also can’t forget how Re-Destro wasn’t as fleshed out in the anime since the manga not only featured more of his backstory but also highlighted his violent and psychotic nature when it came to the goals of Destro. Additionally, Spinner’s origin was the most crucial part of his character writing, but the anime didn’t dive deeper into his mindset when he joined the League of Villains. A lot of his inner monologue was missing from the anime that made his origin story less memorable.

My Hero Academia Season 5 Suffered From the Movie Promotion

My Hero Academia has released four non-canon movies , all of which were unarguably major successes across the box office and streaming services. The animation studio often worked with Horikoshi for the story and the character designs to ensure that fans wouldn’t be disappointed with the release. My Hero Academia: World Heroes’ Mission was released when the anime was still airing its fifth season. This is why Studio Bones swapped the Endeavor Agency arc and the My Villain Academia arc to sync with the theatrical release of the movie.

The anime suffered from the jumbled-up arcs and the pacing issues while also reducing the tension of the story, especially for anime-only fans. My Villain Academia ran for 23 chapters in the manga, but the anime condensed it to six episodes, which severely rushed things for the villains. This is a huge difference compared to the Joint Training Arc, which ran for 24 chapters but was adapted into 10 episodes in the anime.

Since the Endeavor Agency Arc aired before My Villain Academia, fans already knew that the League of Villains fought against the Meta Liberation Army and survived. This is something that the manga didn’t reveal until the fight was over, as it kept building up the tension since the battle between villain organizations could have been in anyone’s favor. The League of Villains not only survived, but also joined the Army as high-ranking Commanders for the Paranormal Liberation War.

Do you think the anime could’ve handled the adaptation of My Villain Academia differently? Which change from the manga disappointed you the most? Share your thoughts in the comments!

title: Family Guy Sets Hulu Release Date for 2026 Holiday Special – Watch First Look Trailer
content:
Family Guy is coming back to Hulu with a new holiday special later this month, and it has now set a release date with the streamer with the first trailer showing it all off. Family Guy has gone through a notable schedule shift in the last few years as with Fox moving it over to midseason, and it means that the Fall comes and goes without new seasons of the series . But thankfully, Family Guy has made up for it with holiday specials streaming with Hulu instead.

Much like seen with the last couple of years, Family Guy has been releasing two holiday specials exclusively with Hulu for the Halloween and Christmas holidays. Following the launch of this year’s Halloween special earlier this Fall , the new Christmas special episode is now set to make its debut with Hulu on November 30th. Giving fans the first look at what to expect from the new holiday special for the year, you can check out the new Family Guy trailer below.

When Does Family Guy ‘s 2026 Christmas Special Come Out?

“ Family Guy 2026 Holiday Special will be making its streaming debut with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ on November 30th . Titled “The Peter Clause,” the synopsis for the episode teases it’s going to be as wacky of a time as it looks, It’s Christmas in Quahog, and Peter and the guys compete to become the town’s official Santa,” the synopsis begins before really getting into the meat of the matter for the episode. “Peter loses, and he can either process his disappointment in a mature manner, or give fans a memorable episode of ‘Family Guy.’ Thankfully, he chooses option number two.”

The Family Guy holiday specials have been a bit hit-or-miss thus far, but they have been moving in the right direction . The first time these specials came to Hulu as a result of the Fox schedule adjustment, it had initially seemed like they were just extra episodes produced during the usual season that had just been released in the gap. But as seen with the latest examples of the holiday specials, it’s clear that the production team really has gone all out for each occasion.

What’s Next for Family Guy in 2027?

Family Guy will be returning in full with Season 25 sometime early next year as part of the midseason schedule with Fox. No release date has not been announced as of this time, but it’s going to be released alongside new episodes of Bob’s Burgers at the same time (which has also now made the move to midseason starting next year). But there’s even much more of the animated franchise coming our way in the new year too with a whole new spinoff series.

Stewie is getting his own spinoff series titled Stewie. Releasing sometime in the 2027-2028 window , this new spinoff series will see Stewie heading to a new preschool and meeting a group of new characters. He’ll naturally still be involved with the main series, but now it’s all going to expand even further from then on. What do you think of this first look at Family Guy ‘s new holiday special for the year? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Singer Yukio Yamagata Dies at 69
content:
Yamagata was scheduled to perform at the "Super Sentai Soul XX 2026" concert in Tokyo on November 7, but was unable to attend due to illness. The concert's planner Birthday Song later revealed his death.

Yamagata was born on March 11, 1957, in Fukuoka Prefecture.

He performed the theme song for the live-action Hyakujuu Sentai Gaoranger and Unofficial Sentai Akibaranger tokusatsu series. He also performed theme songs for the Yattodetaman , Bakusō Kyōdai Let's & Go!! , Galactic Gale Baxinger , Nora , and Acrobunch - The Quest for Treasure anime.

He has also voiced characters in Soreike! Anpanman , Mobile Suit Victory Gundam , Iron Leaguer , and Digital Devil Story: Megami Tensei . He made a cameo appearance as himself in the live-action Unofficial Sentai Akibaranger series.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Confirms Multiple Havens Will Be Revealed With First Story Details
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens has revealed the first details of what to expect from Season 2’s new story, and has teased that there will be the reveal of an unexpected new Haven than what has been previously teased thus far. The end of the debut season saw Pavi and Jae leave Ellora with the intent of journeying to the other Havens to not only help those in need, but unlock more of her chakra powers within her . But only the Floating Isles had been seen coming next.

Avatar: Seven Havens’ Season One finale teased that Pavi would be heading to the Floating Isles as the next major location on her journey, but the first story synopsis for Season 2 revealed by Paramount+ confirm that we’ll also see the New Ba Sing Se location before the season comes to an end. Which means there will be at least two of the Havens explored with the coming season of the series, and makes for a good pace towards its end.

Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Confirms Floating Isles and New Ba Sing Se

“In Book 2, entitled ‘Discovery’, Pavi continues her chakra journey to the Floating Isles and learns more about what happened to Korra,” the synopsis for Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 begins as it further confirms the teases of more of Korra’s future in the coming season . But the synopsis also teases Nisha’s journey in the new episodes, “Meanwhile, Nisha discovers vital information about the mysterious spirit energy Pavi released from Ellora.” The juiciest detail comes towards the end of the synopsis as it sets up their reunion.

“The girls are brought together in New Ba Sing Se, along with all their unresolved issues,” the synopsis ends. Not only does this fully reveal that Pavi will be heading to the Floating Isles as seen with the first season finale, but Avatar: Seven Havens will also fully reveal the third of the Havens, New Ba Sing Se as Pavi and Nisha will be reunited. With Avatar: Seven Havens also revealing that it’s going to end with only four seasons , it does make sense that we’d see at least more than one Haven in the seasons to come in order to reach that end point within a suitable amount of time.

When Does Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Come Out?

Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Episodes 1-3 will be making their worldwide debut with Paramount+ on May 21, 2027, followed by the release of Episodes 4-6 on May 28th, Episodes 7-9 on June 4th, and the final batch of Episodes 10-13 on June 11th. With the series revealing it’s going to end with Season 4 soon after, it’s likely that it’s all going to wrap up by 2028 with all four seasons completely the story.

Given how big of a response the series has gotten with its first season alone, it’s likely going to be even bigger with more locations, more powers, and more lore unlocked.

title: After 9 Years, Black Clover Finally Reveals Noelle’s True Feelings for Asta
content:
Black Clover has been sitting on this one ever since the TV anime kicked off its run nearly a decade ago, but the newest episode of the second season has finally seen Noelle Silva accept her real feelings of love for Asta. Black Clover Season 2 has been working its way through the Spade Kingdom Raid arc, and it has pit Asta and the others against the Dark Triad through all of the episodes seen thus far. It’s been a particularly tough arc for Noelle amidst all of it too.

After Noelle had lost to Vanica back in the first season of the series, Black Clover Season 2 has been able to show off the fruits of her mana training in the Heart Kingdom. This has made her stronger than ever before as she’s been surviving thus far, and the latest episode of the series sees Noelle pushing beyond her limits once Asta arrives to help her . It’s through seeing Asta in this situation that Noelle herself realizes that she really does love him as he’s been able to get her back to her senses.

Black Clover Season 2 Finally Confirms Noelle’s Love for Asta

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 7 continues the fight against the Supreme Devil Megicula after she emerged from Vanica’s body. Noelle and the others had hit a wall through the limits of her power, but Asta soon arrives to help with his anti-magic just in time to keep Megicula from killing Lolopechka with a suicidal magic explosion. This gives Noelle the hope she needed to keep going on, and it’s in this moment that Noelle realizes what she has been fighting back against this whole time. Because while she was telling herself different, she really does love Asta.

Knowing that Asta had already been recklessly pushing beyond his own limits to even help in that moment, Noelle realizes that he’s put his complete faith in her. In the moment she knows that just the fact that he came to save her at all, and just in thinking about Asta while she fights, it’s enough for Noelle to push through for one final attack against Megicula. It’s in this thought giving her strength that Noelle accepts her true feelings, and now moves forward with all of that in mind at last.

What Does This Mean for Noelle’s Future in Black Clover ?

Noelle has been the third major character in the series along with Asta and Yuno as she’s gotten plenty of development and improvement over all of the arcs thus far. This arc sees her become a Saint Stage level fighter with the use of Undine , and through that ability she’s able to deal the final blow to the Supreme Devil. It’s going to keep her in the action as everything continues to ramp up from here on out, but Asta’s still going to be much further away than that.

We’ve only seen Asta show any kind of romantic interest in his childhood crush, Sister Lily, so it’s unclear how he views Noelle or her romantic rival Mimosa Vermilion. He’s been squarely focused on fighting and getting stronger, but their time together as Black Bulls has made Noelle a dear friend to Asta until now. We’ll just have to see if Noelle actually acts on her feelings, so how do you feel about this development? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Earns US$8 Million in 73% Drop at U.S. Box Office, Passes US$100 Million Worldwide
content:
In related news, Legendary Entertainment 's new live-action film of CAPCOM 's Street Fighter game series dropped from #11 to #16 in the U.S. box office, earning about US$760,000 last weekend. The film has also earned over US$100 million worldwide. The Street Fighter film opened on October 16, ranking #1 in the United States, and earning US$30,775,377 in its first three days.

Godzilla Minus Zero earned an estimated US$31.61 million at the North American box office in its opening weekend. A record 74% of that total came from premium large format screenings, with 40% or US$12 million from IMAX screenings. (It is the first Japanese film to meet the standard to advertise itself as "filmed for IMAX.")

This is the highest ever U.S. opening weekend for a GKIDS release (higher than The Boy and the Heron 's US$13 million in 2023 ), as well as the highest one ever for a live-action foreign film. (The highest one for a foreign film is still the first Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle anime film with US$70.6 million, unadjusted for inflation, in September 2025. The English dub of Pokémon: The First Movie opened with US$50.8 million in its first five days in July 1998.)

Godzilla Minus Zero 's global revenue stands at US$63 million after its opening weekend. Deadline reports it was the highest-grossing film in the world this past weekend.

The film earned 590,000 tickets for 910 million yen (about US$5.75 million) in Japan in its opening day alone, setting a new record for the highest opening day earnings for a live-action film (among both foreign and domestic live-action films) in Japan. The film had 201% higher opening day earnings than its predecessor Godzilla Minus One in Japan.

The film opened in Japan on Tuesday, November 3, which is "Godzilla Day" in Japan, celebrating the anniversary of the first Godzilla film's November 3, 1954 release. Godzilla Minus One similarly opened in Japan on November 3, 2023. (Godzilla Day fell on a Tuesday this year, but it is also the Japanese holiday known as Culture Day.)

The sequel is set in 1949, two years after the Godzilla Minus One film's story.
